# Overview  {-}

```{r "intro"}
#| echo: false
intro <- tryCatch(
    {
        library(htmltools)
        description <- packageDescription("OMAextras")
        pkg <- description$Package
        version <- description$Version
        authors <- eval(parse(text = description$Authors))
        license <- description$License
        glue::glue(
            "**Package:** {pkg}<br/>\n",
            "**Authors:<br/>** {
                authors |>
                    format(include = c('given', 'family', 'role')) |>
                    paste('- ', x = _) |>
                    paste(collapse = '<br/> ')
            }<br/>\n",
            "**Compiled:** {as.character(Sys.Date())}<br/>\n",
            "**Package version:** {version}<br/>\n",
            "**R version:** {R.version.string}<br/>\n",
            "**BioC version:** {BiocManager::version()}<br/>\n",
            "**License:** {license}<br/>"
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
        "Local preview"
    }
)
```
